scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Six bearded men in earth-colored robes gather around a low wooden table in a sunlit stone room. An elderly man in pale robes clasps hands with a man in a rust-red mantle while four others watch. A small oil lamp burns on the table; leafy branches are visible through the window. Warm watercolor washes reveal woven cloth and textured stone.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative gathering portrays Jehoiada's resolve and his covenant with the five named commanders. The handclasp expresses agreement; the verse does not specify this gesture, room, clothing or faces. The fathers' names identify the commanders and are not represented as additional people. The setting and appearances are illustrative conventions, not historical likenesses or archaeological certainty.
